newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER-MAN UTD LOSE, MIDDLESBROUGH INTO CUP SEMIFINALS.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-MAN UTD LOSE, MIDDLESBROUGH INTO CUP SEMIFINALS.

text.p: Manchester United's hopes of extending their lead at the top of the English premier league were foiled on Saturday as the champions lost 2-1 at struggling Sunderland.
It was their first league defeat since November 2.
Dennis Bergkamp scored twice as Arsenal closed to within three points of the leaders with a 2-0 win over Nottingham Forest while third-placed Liverpool host Newcastle on Monday night.

In the day's only F.A. Cup quarter-final, goals by Brazilian Juninho and Italian Fabrizio Ravanelli gave Middlesbrough a 2-0 win at Derby and a place in the semifinals for the first time in the club's 121-year history
Saturday's other premier league games saw Everton's poor run continue with a 1-0 defeat at Leeds while Coventry and Leicester battled out a goalless draw at Highfield Road.
The remaining three Cup quarter-finals are being played on Sunday.
